name: Bamboo sticky rice
summary: Sticky rice cooked in a bamboo tube, named among Ban Ang’s local dishes. Eat it from the tube at a village meal. The photograph is that dish on a plate, and it was not taken in Moc Chau. A price is check on arrival.
origin: A 2012 provincial feature names cơm lam among Ban Ang’s local dishes. The photograph is a plate of bamboo-tube sticky rice. It was not taken at Ban Ang.
howToEat: Eat it from the tube at a Ban Ang meal. Salt, sesame, and a dipping sauce are not on that page. Check on arrival.
No stall price was recorded. The price is check on arrival.
where: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43. The photograph shows the rice in the tube. It does not show the village, and the skewer beside the rice is not a sourced pa pỉnh tộp.
